label: Blind sample null 051: intact forest, no Hansen loss 2001-2023, tile 00N_110E

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) rose by 0.13 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2022 (90% interval −0.56 to +0.35). The same test was run on 7 untouched control cells. In 4 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.62). Counted by gap size instead, 2 of the 7 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.38). But: only 7 usable control cells (need 20); the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.08 vs typical 0.05).
reasons: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.08 vs typical 0.05)

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
